topic: Solar System Planet Sizes and Distances
key_concepts: The solar system is composed of the Sun, eight planets, and other celestial bodies.
Planets travel around the Sun through elliptical orbits.
Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are inner terrestrial planets found inside the asteroid be
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are outer Jovian planets found outside the asteroid b
The asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter separates the inner and outer planets.
Inner planets have diameters less than 13,000 kilometers.
Outer giant planets have diameters exceeding 48,000 kilometers.
